classes.name: Normal
classes.description: Explicitly verified cognitively/neurologically normal control subjects (Documented coverage gap)

classes.name: Glioma
classes.description: High-grade or low-grade infiltrative glial brain tumor (Trained on native T1w)

classes.name: Meningioma
classes.description: Dural-based extra-axial meningeal brain tumor (Trained on native t1n)

classes.name: Metastasis
classes.description: Secondary brain metastatic focal lesions (Trained on native t1n)

classes.name: Alzheimer's
classes.description: Alzheimer's disease neurodegeneration including folded MCI (Documented coverage gap: no verified whole-brain ADNI/OASIS T1 on disk)

classes.name: FCD epilepsy
classes.description: Focal Cortical Dysplasia epilepsy (Expected coverage gap)

classes.name: Post-stroke lesion
classes.description: Post-stroke ischemic or hemorrhagic encephalomalacia lesion (Expected coverage gap)

classes.name: Uncertain/Other
classes.description: Out-of-distribution, equivocal pathology, unrepresented classes, or low-confidence scans

rules: Absence of a label is NEVER assumed to be healthy or Normal.
Only subjects explicitly labeled as controls by origin registry count as Normal.
Do NOT derive diagnoses from brain volumes, thresholds, or heuristics.
Do NOT use 2D tumor images or slices for 3D volumetric classification.
Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) must be folded into Alzheimer's.
MSD Task04 Hippocampus must NOT be labeled as Alzheimer's (cropped bounding boxes, no diagnosis labels).
All trained models use native T1 (no contrast). t1c is strictly removed.
Unsupported classes (Normal, Alzheimer's, FCD epilepsy, Post-stroke lesion, Parkinson's, ASD) are routed to Uncertain/Other.

MSD_Task04_Hippocampus.reason: Cropped ~40^3 hippocampal bounding boxes without clinical dementia/AD diagnosis labels. Induces artificial volumetric shortcut learning.

MultipleSclerosis_MSLesSeg.reason: Multiple Sclerosis is absent from the 10 official ACIT26 classes and induces high false-positive lesion hallucinations. Routed to Uncertain/Other.
